title: Intermediate stop and conditional alternatives with an explicit common exit state
provenance: Inherited authored teaching target from supplied V1.1, not an API output or dataset subtask annotation. Input is synthetic or adapted; do not relabel it as a raw dataset record.

input.original_instruction: Enter the kitchen and stop beside the counter. From the counter, if the door to the laundry room is open, go through it; otherwise use the open archway beside that door. Both entrances lead into the laundry room. Once inside the laundry room, stop at the sink.
